Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000918": As of 2025-12-08, the indexer lives with Team Dune; Team Cinder kept it until then.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000914": As of 2025-12-08, the pager for the indexer rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000832": On 2025-11-06, Team Dune reported that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send.  (about: Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000776" [decision]: The INC-2025-023 review on 2025-10-16 decided that reindex jobs will page on failure.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex jobs)
- memory_id "1000773": A silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex jobs)
- memory_id "1000769": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex jobs)
- memory_id "1000765": INC-2025-023 was an incident affecting the indexer on 2025-10-13.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000753": As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000709" [decision]: On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger, Team Dune, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000671": On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000646": The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer)
- memory_id "1000642" [constraint]: The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000580" [decision]: On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder's standup decided that clients will cache feature-flags service evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: Team Cinder, feature-flags service, clients)
- memory_id "1000502": On 2025-06-23, Team Cinder observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Cinder, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000476": Dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed as of 2025-06-16.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000406": On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the catalog service is not Team Boreal's service.  (about: Team Boreal, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000368": On 2025-04-18, Team Atlas reported that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000327": The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000324" [decision]: On 2025-04-04, Team Dune agreed that the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000255": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000198": The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents.  (about: catalog service, indexer)
